prompt.name: Biplane (First World War)
prompt.look: A First World War biplane: two cream canvas wings stacked one above the other, joined by wooden struts and taut bracing wires, a round engine cowling at the nose on the right with a two-blade wooden propeller, an open cockpit with a goggled pilot in a leather helmet, a tail fin and rudder at the left end, and two small wheels under the nose. The whole fuselage and the tail are painted in one solid colour.
prompt.gear: The two wheels hang under the nose exactly as in a normal side view and nothing else hangs below the fuselage. Wings, struts and wires are straight and do not overlap the propeller.
prompt.identity: the same two wings, struts, wires, engine cowling, propeller, cockpit and pilot, tail and wheels, and the same red fuselage and tail
prompt.damage_gear: a snapped bracing wire and a torn wing patch
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a bent strut and a cracked propeller

the aircraft jolted and the nose dipped, built in code
